summary: Iteration 21 — Verified report-templates (21 across 9 categories), report save fix, dashboard share link + shared viewer. Backend 7/7 pytest pass. Frontend end-to-end validated on TUSAS: template dropdown shows 9 categories with correct counts (İşgücü 4, Ücret 1, Çeşitlilik 1, Performans 1, İşe Alım 4, Eğitim 3, Bağlılık 2, Yetenek 2, KPI Dashboard 3 = 21), clicking template-0 creates a report instantly, manual Save works, dashboard editor flow completes (Yeni Dashboard → Widget Ekle → Kaydet → Yayınla → Paylaş → share banner → /shared/dashboard/{token} renders name+widget). Two React bugs found & fixed to make the flow work as described in the request.

bugs_found_and_fixed_by_tester.issue: publishDashboard() did not update activeDashboard state; share button conditional (activeDashboard?.status === 'published') stayed false so Paylaş never appeared in the editor after clicking Yayınla — user had to leave and re-open the dashboard.
bugs_found_and_fixed_by_tester.fix: publishDashboard now captures response and setActiveDashboard(prev => ({...prev, ...r.data, status:'published'})).

bugs_found_and_fixed_by_tester.issue: Share link banner JSX was mistakenly nested INSIDE the {showAddWidget && ...} 'Add Widget' modal block. Banner therefore never rendered when Paylaş was clicked (Add Widget modal was closed).
bugs_found_and_fixed_by_tester.fix: Moved <share-link-banner> out of the Add Widget modal, placed it directly under the editor toolbar.

verified_endpoints.POST /api/report-designer/report-templat: creates report, no _id leak, tenant scoped ✅

frontend_playwright_flow./admin/rapor/tusas/rapor-tasarimcisi: Hazır Şablonlar section with 9 category buttons visible, template-0 click created a report (5→6) ✅
frontend_playwright_flow.Manual report save: TEST_iter21_ui_report created via Yeni Rapor → Kaydet, appears in list ✅
frontend_playwright_flow./admin/rapor/tusas/dashboard-yonetimi Ye: opens editor, widget added, Kaydet + Yayınla succeed ✅
frontend_playwright_flow.Paylaş button (after fix): appears immediately in editor after Yayınla ✅
frontend_playwright_flow.Share banner (after fix): green banner with copyable URL visible after Paylaş click ✅
frontend_playwright_flow./shared/dashboard/{token}: renders dashboard name + widget table (rows visible: TSK10000…TSK10010, columns: id/name/gender/age/hire_date/department/job_title) ✅

seed_data_creation: Test dashboard TEST_iter21_dash_ui and reports TEST_iter21_ui_report + one 'Departman Bazlı Headcount' template report were created during UI tests and cleaned up at the end. TUSAS existing 5 reports preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter21_templates_and_share.py covers templates + share flows end-to-end. UI flow: login → /admin/rapor/tusas/rapor-tasarimcisi (template-0 testid, save-report-btn) → /admin/rapor/tusas/dashboard-yonetimi (new-dashboard-btn → add-widget-btn → add-report-{id} → save-dashboard-btn → publish-dashboard-btn → share-dashboard-btn → share-link-banner) → /shared/dashboard/{token}. Two JSX/state bugs in DashboardManagerPage were fixed by tester to enable the flow described in the request.
rca_of_the_issue: Two bugs blocked the share flow: (1) publishDashboard() awaited the publish API but only called loadAll() which refreshes dashboards[] but never updates the local activeDashboard state — so the conditional `activeDashboard?.status === 'published'` remained stale and Paylaş button never appeared. Fixed by merging response into activeDashboard. (2) The share-link-banner JSX was accidentally placed inside the `{showAddWidget && (...)}` Add-Widget modal branch, so it only ever rendered while the Add Widget modal was open. Moved it out of the modal into the editor toolbar area. Backend endpoints for both share and template flows work correctly and were verified by pytest.
